decisions.reason: It builds directly on the firm's core plant-engineering and automation knowledge, and with strong in-house R&D the firm is likely to refine this integrated machine rather than withdraw it quickly, although the recent fast discontinuation of several 2023 robot variants shows some portfolio-pruning discipline.

Production analysis software is close to the firm's existing controls, software and lifecycle-support capabilities and fits its move toward automated, data-driven precast plants, so the firm has high absorptive capacity to learn from early use and improve it.
